script: A fish thought to have died out with the dinosaurs was found alive in 1938. It is called the coelacanth, and it was believed extinct for about 66 million years. A museum curator in South Africa, Marjorie Courtenay-Latimer, spotted one in a fisherman's catch. A second species was found in Indonesia in the late 1990s. Coelacanths have fleshy, limb-like fins. A 2021 study suggests they can live for about 100 years. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
